description: Na₄CO₄ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.76 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent O atoms. There are three shorter (2.29 Å) and three longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (1.45 Å) and three longer (1.46 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to six equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to six Na and one C atom.
